scope: PDF clause locators verified against the locally supplied ISO 32000-2:2020 text. Two-range coverage, strict physical source binding and conservative object-level policy comparisons are verification policy; independent result aspects follow ADR 0015. Document views are structural, and structural permission never establishes cryptographic validity; the facade integrity stage is tracked separately in cms-signatures.json.

requirements.description: Typed fields, signature dictionaries and UR3, including empty fields and encoded metadata. Catalog Perms/DocMDP links to its certification signature. Malformed discovered dictionaries and locks are per-field errors.
Two ordered in-bounds ranges exclude exactly the physical hexadecimal Contents token. Signed chunks borrow original bytes.
requirements.gaps: CMS verification is provided separately by the facade. Compressed signature dictionaries cannot establish a physical token binding.

requirements.description: Coverage matches parsed Prev-chain terminators. Historical object reads use lazy strict prefixes with generation-aware xref data, shared source bytes and aggregate cache accounting. Removed or replaced signatures remain discoverable. Linearized first-page and main xref sections describe one base revision in Prev-chain order; optional early EOF markers are ignored.
requirements.gaps: Repaired or unconfirmed history is inconclusive. Historical encrypted access is unsupported and history_complete reports incomplete signature discovery.

requirements.description: Typed DocMDP permissions, FieldMDP selections, UR parameters and field locks; supported restrictions are frozen at the signed revision.
requirements.gaps: Transform digest validation and deprecated usage-rights enforcement are not implemented.

requirements.description: Independent integrity, coverage, modification, trust, time, revocation and algorithm states follow ADR 0015 decision 2.
requirements.gaps: Facade CMS integrity is tracked in cms-signatures.json and permitted changes in signature-permitted-changes. Trust, clock trust and revocation remain unchecked here. Legacy encodings remain unsupported; adbe.pkcs7.sha1 is weak, and the adbe.x509.rsa_sha1 name alone does not identify its digest (Table 260 note a).

requirements.description: Per-object and trailer decisions under signed DocMDP P=1/2/3 and FieldMDP All/Include/Exclude restrictions. Xref deltas include redefined object-stream members and indirect-Length dependencies. Reachable roles are shared across signatures from the oldest covered signed revision; undefined references are null and unrelated slots stay lazy; cumulative results retain reverted violations. All owners must authorize associated appearance changes. Annotation and widget changes, signing appearances and added AP entries, including indirect null-to-appearance transitions, report visible_overlay without changing permission. Large-file fixtures are authored in Rust tests at run time.
requirements.gaps: Structural decisions are conditional on cryptographic verification. Unsupported roles, transformations, template instantiation, document information, non-catalog FieldMDP Data targets and DSS/timestamp exceptions are inconclusive. No usage rights are granted. Historical encryption or repaired source makes discovery incomplete and analysis inconclusive. Shared change-analysis budget exhaustion preserves structural and ByteRange results and reports changes inconclusive.
